## Drift: drafters vs the prediction model at the same staleness

Drafter loss = current twin's head-to-head win % over the stale version minus 50 (pp). Edge lost = BT logit gap current minus stale, as a share of the current drafter's BT edge over GD. Prediction lift lost = share of the log-loss lift over a coin flip lost at that staleness (tournament-window games).
